summary: Add semcod/taskill doc-hygiene candidates to export

delivery.outcome: Add `monag export --hygiene`: a taskill-doc-drift candidate for every repository where semcod/taskill's own read-only `status` command (never `run` -- monag never asks an external tool to write) reports it would update README/CHANGELOG/TODO, carrying taskill's own reasons as evidence. A missing binary or a per-repository failure is an explicit recorded error, never silently treated as clean.
nonGoals: monag never invokes `taskill run`; only the read-only `status` subcommand.
monag does not vendor, install, or require taskill; it is an optional external tool.
No write access to README/CHANGELOG/TODO of any scanned repository.

architecture.decision: Add taskill_available()/taskill_candidates() to src/monag/export.py, reusing monitor.command() (no stdin needed, unlike ticket-radar). Wire a new --hygiene flag on the export subcommand; no new runtime dependency since taskill is invoked as an external binary, not imported.
architecture.rollback: Revert the application slice through protected review.

validation.evidence: Hygiene candidate generation (available/missing/clean/dirty) and CLI wiring regression suite passes.
